motivation.m117_p0: identity-only prefetch omitted the 768-bit payload path; a synchronous 256-bit port returns load beat2 in the first-event cycle and requires tail bypass
motivation.m118_p0: standalone signed19 accumulator lacks an integrated accepted-transaction exact-once mapper
motivation.performance_guard: avoid one uncounted synchronous-memory tail cycle per active key

architecture.tail_bypass: beat2 response is combined with stored beats0/1 while the immediately following first event is accepted
architecture.polarity: each signed INT8 lane is sign-extended to signed19 and optionally negated
architecture.output_elasticity: one-entry update skid supports simultaneous retire and next event
architecture.fault_policy: malformed beat/key/type sequence is sticky fail-closed for new service; an older accepted update may still drain

paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS verifies a standalone three-beat 256-bit synchronous-weight mapper whose beat2 tail bypass supplies the immediately following first event without an extra service cycle, mapping all 96 signed INT8 lanes into signed19 deltas under polarity and backpressure. M117/M118 integration, foundry SRAM and the 2.535462x projection remain pending.
prohibited_claims: Do not call a behavioral fixed-latency response a foundry SRAM macro.
Do not call 129 directed tail-bypass checks full-trace or integrated cycle admission.
Do not call directed token conservation a heldout duplicate/retry proof.
Do not promote the M109 2.535462x projection to RTL, physical, system or headline speedup.
